title: A modern magyar irodalom: A Nyugattól a Nobel-díjig
grammar: Literary Renewal & Moral Testimony: Megújít, tanúságot tesz, elnyer

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name the writers of the Nyugat generation and later Hungarian authors and their works.
I can say who won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2002.
I can use verbs of renewal and witness (*megújít*, *tanúságot tesz*, *elnyer*).
I can use words for a literary journal, a value system and a prize.
